turns.text: Hi, I placed an order recently but bought the wrong size. I want to cancel it.

An order can be cancelled while it’s paid and production hasn’t started. Staff must approve the refund. Please send your order number and the email used for the order so I can check whether cancellation is possible.

rule.ro: O comandă se poate anula cât timp este plătită și producția nu a început. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: An order can be cancelled while it is paid and production has not started. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Order SC-4050, email sarah.jenkins.v2@example.com. Please cancel the order.
Your cancellation request has been submitted and is pending staff approval. The order isn’t cancelled yet; staff must also approve any refund.
